topic.title: highest-number-among-3-numbers
topic.description: To find the highest number among 3 numbers.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Start with the first number as the champion and let each new number challenge it — one comparison at a time.
learningNotes.challenges: I never check the numbers I read, so three missing answers compare garbage.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Check the reads, and put one comment on the `max = a` line saying why the first number is the starting champion.

files.description: To find the highest number among 3 numbers.

misconceptions: `scanf` returns how many items it read — the value is only ever set if you check that, so a missing answer leaves the variable untouched
Starting the champion at the first value is what makes the loop-free version work — there is no 'nothing seen yet' state to handle
engine.review:
**The rubric I used**

There is no task sheet for this one — it was written before the engine
existed, so there was nothing to grade it against. I graded the file on the
three things that have always mattered here:

- **40 — it runs.** It compiles or interprets without an error.
- **30 — it is right.** The output is what it claims to produce.
- **30 — it explains itself.** Comments say *why*, not *what*.

**40 + 30 + 0 = 70%**

**What is solid**

This is the clean version of the problem. `max` starts as `a`, then `b` is compared against it and `c` is compared against it. Given 3, 9 and 5 it prints `The highest number is 9`. It compiles clean, and it is shorter than the nested-`if` version in this same folder — which is worth noticing: two files, one question, and this one needs no nesting at all.

**What is not**

The three numbers are read without being checked, so all three can be missing. And there is no comment on the one line that carries the idea — `max = a`, which is the reason the rest of the program works: there is no empty state to worry about because the champion starts as a real number.

**The one thing to fix first**

One comment on the first line of the logic:

```c
/* Start the champion as a real number, so there is no empty case. */
max = a;
```

Then check the read.
